column1: # ci-oracle-lane-legs.tsv — leg assignment for the oracle-index-check matrix (#12393; the
# ADR-240 checked-in-assignment shape, same grammar as scripts/suite-shard-legs.tsv).
# Grammar: <registration-label><TAB><leg> where leg is a member of the ci.yml
# `oracle-index-check` `strategy.matrix.leg` set (currently K=5, values 1/5..5/5). The job's
# manifest loop runs ONLY the members whose leg equals ORACLE_LEG; every member executes
# exactly once across the leg set. scripts/ci-oracle-lane.test.sh's check_legs() pins
# legs ≡ manifest parity bi-directionally, every matrix leg non-vacant, leg values ⊆ the
# live matrix set, and no duplicate assignment — membership changes need a row here or the
# sentinel reds.
# Provenance: LPT-packed from scripts/suite-durations.tsv measured 2026-11-08, repacked
# 2026-11-09 after the S4 retirement removed the five retired evidence/lever
# members (the three replay arms, the preactivation suite and the pr-selection suite) —
# serial total ~36.0 min; worst leg is leg 1 (test-all-affected-d alone, ~10.2 min
# measured) + ~1.5 min checkout/fetch ≈ 12 min wall, ~61% under the 30-min bound.
# Rebalance trigger: re-pack when a member's measured duration moves any leg's projected
# total within ~5 min of the bound, or when the manifest gains a member. The manifest
# stays label<TAB>argv (2 fields) — leg assignment lives ONLY here; do not add a manifest
# column (check_manifest MEMBER-BAD-FIELDS).
# regen: manual — repack by editing this file from scripts/suite-durations.tsv totals (see
# Provenance); check_legs() pins legs ≡ manifest parity, matrix coverage and per-leg budget.
